nodes.text: #HMPV is a relatively new virus strain and governments, as well as the WHO want to avoid a world wide panic. The funny thing is, you cannot run away from a virus that is 100x more contagious than Covid-19, has no vaccine developed as this point, nor is there an anti-dote or cure.
